references.text: Noah's three sons Shem, Ham and Japheth are mentioned for the first time
God establishes his covenant with Noah and instructs him to enter the ark together with his family
God commands Noah to enter the ark because of his righteousness
Noah and his family enter the ark to escape the floodwaters
Noah and his sons, his wife and his sons' wives leave the ark after the flood
Noah's faith that led him to build the ark and save his household
Eight souls were saved through water in Noah's ark
God preserved Noah as the eighth, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought the flood upon the ungodly
Narrative symmetry: Confirms that the same people who entered also left, marking the end of the flood.
Theological consequence: The entry into the ark secured the foundation for the restoration of all humanity through these three sons.
Clear allusion: Uses Noah's entry as a typological image of the day of judgment and God's salvation of believers.
